tweets.text: The SEC admitted it destroyed Gary Gensler's text messages. Coinbase sued under FOIA, got $150K and forced reforms to the agency's record-retention policies. Those texts are gone forever. Let that satisfying irony sink in.

BIP352 Silent Payments just landed in libsecp256k1 — 13,853 lines merged into Bitcoin's core crypto library. Stealth receive without address reuse is now a C API call away. Privacy at the protocol level, not the app layer.

Jack Dorsey went from reinventing payments to reinventing the office. Block just shipped a decentralized, open-source group chat platform gunning straight for Slack. The man woke up and chose war with every collaboration tool at once.

wolfSSL ripped out liboqs entirely and shipped native Falcon-512/1024 with SSE2, AVX2, and ARM NEON acceleration. Falcon was the last thing keeping liboqs in the build. Post-quantum TLS just went fully dependency-free.
